title: Local Parts, Whole Relations: A Constructive Audit of Composition in Structural Consciousness Models

claims.statement: Finite gluing existence need not imply uniqueness; exact three-point nonempty-overlap presheaf counterexample.
Free binary relational completion fiber has size 2^k for k uncovered relation atoms, in a fixed labeled signature.
Covering relation-incidence fields repairs unique gluing in the specified free assignment model.
Universal expansion forbids forgetting globally discriminated pairs; nonmetric and pseudometric cases must be separated.
A pseudometric between declared lower and upper bounds exists iff the lower bounds lie below the shortest-path closure of the upper bounds.
Exact uniform relaxation is the maximum path-average deficit; classical shortest-path construction, not a new generic algorithm.
Same-context restriction and attention-induced intervention require separate transport and error assumptions.
